representation.name: ABO O deletion window q1
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
mkdir work
cd work
tar -xzf "$(inputs.archive.path)"
plink2 --pfile match.genotypes.1.1 --chr 9 --from-bp 133257500 --to-bp 133257550 --export A --out odel > plink.log 2>&1
{
  printf 'PVAR_WINDOW\n'
  grep '^9[[:space:]]' match.genotypes.1.1.pvar | grep -E '^9[[:space:]]+1332575[0-5][0-9][[:space:]]' || true
  printf '\nRAW\n'
  cat odel.raw
  printf '\nLOG\n'
  cat plink.log
} > ../odel_window.txt
